name: io.github.ClickHouse/mcp-clickhouse
title: ClickHouse
description: Official ClickHouse MCP server for querying and exploring ClickHouse clusters and chDB.

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Hostname of the ClickHouse server

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_USER
environmentVariables.description: Username for ClickHouse authentication

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for ClickHouse authentication. Required unless a client certificate uses the default or mutual TLS mode

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: ClickHouse HTTP(S) port. Defaults to 8443 when CLICKHOUSE_SECURE=true, 8123 otherwise

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_SECURE
environmentVariables.description: Use HTTPS to connect to ClickHouse

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Verify SSL certificates

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_CA_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Path to a PEM CA bundle for ClickHouse server certificate verification

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Path to a PEM client certificate for the ClickHouse HTTPS connection

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT_CERT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the PEM private key for CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT_CERT

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_TLS_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Client certificate mode: mutual, proxy, or strict

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE
environmentVariables.description: Default database to use

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_ROLE
environmentVariables.description: ClickHouse role to activate for the session

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_ALLOW_WRITE_ACCESS
environmentVariables.description: Allow write operations (DDL and DML). Queries run read-only by default

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_ALLOW_DROP
environmentVariables.description: Allow destructive operations (DROP, TRUNCATE, DELETE, UPDATE, REPLACE, CLEAR, and DETACH PERMANENTLY) when write access is also enabled

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_MCP_QUERY_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Query tool timeout in seconds

environmentVariables.name: CLICKHOUSE_MCP_MAX_WORKERS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum query worker thread pool size
